decisive_items: second (parietal cells) was shortened with mild degeneration
response.rationale: R2 is supported by specific raw histologic evidence of reduced H+/K+-ATPase staining and foveolar hyperplasia, indicating atrophic gastritis; R1 only cites nonspecific lymphocytic infiltration and the same foveolar hyperplasia, lacking the direct gastric-atrophy marker. C1, an append-only completion of R2, adds only the biopsy-site heading as raw support and does not independently provide diagnostic raw evidence, so it is discounted as a correlated restatement.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R2; its sole raw span is the non-diagnostic heading 'Histologic findings (lesser curvature of corpus)', which does not support atrophic gastritis by itself, making it a correlated restatement without independent diagnostic weight.
